mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the aspects of biblical criticism that grew out of source criticism."
Form criticism is one of the aspects of biblical criticism that grew out of source criticism.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is concerned with analyzing a text through its language."
Grammatical criticism is concerned with analyzing a text through its language.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a rigorous approach to textual criticism developed by Karl Lachmann (1793-1851) and others."
Stemmatics is a rigorous approach to textual criticism developed by Karl Lachmann (1793-1851) and others.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a strange, badly written Latin list with brief comments on the books read in the church."
The Muratorian Canon is a strange, badly written Latin list with brief comments on the books read in the church.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the first Christian scholar to engage in researching and writing a complete history of the Christian church."
Eusebius is the first Christian scholar to engage in researching and writing a complete history of the Christian church.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an apocalyptic, grass-roots church movement of inspiration and speaking in tongues very reminiscent of revivalist movements emphasizing eschatology that arise still to this day."
Montanism is an apocalyptic, grass-roots church movement of inspiration and speaking in tongues very reminiscent of revivalist movements emphasizing eschatology that arise still to this day.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the discipline and study of the actual wordings of the Bible."
Textual criticism is the discipline and study of the actual wordings of the Bible.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ can be defined as a highly stylized form of literature with its own conventions of symbolism and terminology which feeds on Old Testament sources continually."
Apocalyptic literature can be defined as a highly stylized form of literature with its own conventions of symbolism and terminology which feeds on Old Testament sources continually.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a conflation of the two-source hypothesis."
Four document hypothesis is a conflation of the two-source hypothesis.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the errors that have crept into the New Testament in the process of copying the text of the New Testament."
Scribal errors are the errors that have crept into the New Testament in the process of copying the text of the New Testament.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the fourth gospel in the canon of the New Testament."
The Gospel of John is the fourth gospel in the canon of the New Testament.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is derived from 'epistole' which refers to any kind of letter The epistolary structure includes: address, greetings, thanksgiving/prayer wish, main body and closing."
Epistle is derived from 'epistole' which refers to any kind of letter The epistolary structure includes: address, greetings, thanksgiving/prayer wish, main body and closing.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a perennial problem of textual criticism."
Assessing its readings is a perennial problem of textual criticism.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the only form of the gospel material that seems as an exception to the assumption that there were no connected narratives of the life of Jesus in the earliest period."
The Passion narrative is the only form of the gospel material that seems as an exception to the assumption that there were no connected narratives of the life of Jesus in the earliest period.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a series of sermons by the Syrian Father Ephraem."
The upper writing is a series of sermons by the Syrian Father Ephraem.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an uncial of the fourth century (probably copied around AD 350), and widely regarded as the most important surviving Biblical manuscript."
Codex Vaticanus is an uncial of the fourth century (probably copied around AD 350), and widely regarded as the most important surviving Biblical manuscript.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the standard critical text for today."
NA28 is the standard critical text for today.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the doctrine in Christian theology concerned with the divine origin of the Bible and what the Bible teaches about itself."
Biblical inspiration is the doctrine in Christian theology concerned with the divine origin of the Bible and what the Bible teaches about itself.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a book of the Bible, which now stands fifth in the New Testament."
The Acts of the Apostles is a book of the Bible, which now stands fifth in the New Testament.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the four Gospel accounts of the New Testament."
The Gospel of Matthew is one of the four Gospel accounts of the New Testament.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the errors that are made by accident, so they are also called accidental errors."
Unintentional errors are the errors that are made by accident, so they are also called accidental errors.
